business_scope.primary_industry_name: Zinc Alloy Die-Casting and Tampo Printing of 1:18 Scale Car Replicas

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (Common Law statutory framework enriched by customary law and U.S.-influenced corporate jurisprudence)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association with the United States (1986, as amended)
Bilateral Tax Information Exchange Agreement with the United States (1990, applied through the COFA)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Business Corporations Act (BCCA) 1990 (as amended); Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2012 (as amended); Money Laundering (General) Regulations 2013; Marshall Islands Financial Intelligence Unit directives and enhanced due diligence guidance under the Financial Action Task Force framework; Beneficial Ownership Information Regulations issued pursuant to the AML/CFT Act requiring registered agents to maintain and furnish UBO records to the Marshall Islands regulator upon lawful request.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified notarized copy of passport (principal shareholder and director)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport authority or public notary in country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (if issuing state is a Convention party) OR Consular Legalization (Marshall Islands consulate service or recognized agent)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement, issued within 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility company, financial institution, or competent public notary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization as required by the issuing state

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original bank reference letter from senior account officer (entity's financial standing and source of funds)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Bank or licensed financial institution in the account holder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization, including banker's signature notarization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified notarized corporate due diligence questionnaire / UBO declaration form
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registered agent in the Marshall Islands or independent legal counsel
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization when executed outside the Marshall Islands

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized source of funds and source of wealth declaration
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Public notary in the beneficial owner's jurisdiction

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory continuous screening of all directors, shareholders, beneficial owners, and counterparties against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) List, the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, the UK HM Treasury Sanctions List, and the Marshall Islands domestic sanctions and terrorism designations; Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) identification is required across all nationalities and positions, with additional Enhanced Due Diligence, independent source-of-funds verification, and senior management approval for any PEP-related relationship. The risk tier for zinc die-cast scale model manufacturing is Low_Risk_Standard; nevertheless, automatic AML software screening and ongoing transaction monitoring are required by the registered agent and the professional intermediary.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Marshall Islands Corporate Registry online portal (administered by the Office of the Registrar of Corporations, operational delegated to International Registries, Inc. as recognized agent and integrated filing system)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be submitted in the English language using Latin alphabet characters. Any foreign-language or Marshallese components must be transliterated into a phonetic English equivalent and stated within the name reservation application. The corporate name must be distinguishable upon the register, shall not be identical or misleadingly similar to an existing or reserved name, and must contain a corporate suffix such as 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Limited', 'Ltd.', 'Corp.', or 'Inc.' unless a special dispensation is requested.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank, Banking, Trust, Trustee, Insurance, Assurance, Reinsurance, Underwriter, Finance, Financial, Investment, Mutual Fund, Brokerage, Security, Securities, Exchange, Clearing, Settlement, Depository, Credit Union, Money Services, Remittance, Gaming, Casino, Wager
Government, Ministerial, Royal, Sovereign, Central, Reserve, National, Marshal, President
Royal, Imperial, University, Institute, Council, Chamber
The words 'Republic of the Marshall Islands' or 'Marshall Islands' in a manner implying governmental affiliation
Any word indicating a profession or regulated activity without proof of professional license
Offensive, obscene, or contrary to the public order
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant or registered agent must file a written notice of appeal with the Registrar of Corporations within 14 calendar days of the rejection notice. The appeal shall state the full proposed name, the grounds upon which the rejection is believed to be erroneous, and any supporting court or administrative precedent. The Registrar shall respond within 10 business days. If the Registrar affirms the rejection, a separate reservation may be made for alternative names; if the rejection is due to a prohibited or restricted token, the applicant may simultaneously submit for the requisite ministerial license or consent from the relevant competent authority and resubmit the name with that approval.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Allowed. A non-resident Business Corporation must maintain a registered office and registered agent in the Marshall Islands; the registered agent's physical address may serve as the registered office, and commercial activities may be conducted entirely from overseas premises. A physical or administrative virtual office is therefore permissible for corporate filings and service of process, provided all statutory records are maintained at the registered office or an agent-designated address; no requirement exists for a substantive local operating office for a low-risk international trading or manufacturing holding entity, but the entity must not hold itself out as having a physical operational presence in the Marshall Islands unless such presence genuinely exists.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low, approximately 5% annual probability. The Marshall Islands Registrar performs risk-based desk audits and targeted inspections; for a low-risk, non-resident business corporation in the collectibles and die-cast model sector, unannounced on-site physical inspections are uncommon but may be triggered by anomalous transaction volumes, PEP status, adverse media, sanctions flags, or regulatory referrals from foreign authorities.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government name reservation fee (Marshall Islands Corporate Registry)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the BCCA fee schedule as published by the Office of the Registrar

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent and registered office annual service fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for corporate agent services in the Marshall Islands

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing professional benchmark for offshore corporate formation legal advisory

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act 1990 (as amended), codified in Title 48 of the Marshall Islands Revised Code 2021: sections 31-33 (incorporators and Articles of Incorporation), section 35 (Certificate of Incorporation and correction), section 47 (consideration for shares), sections 55-57 (registered office and registered agent), and section 66 (officers).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations (RMI Registrar), Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands; filings are submitted through licensed RMI Registered Agents.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation, executed by the incorporator and acknowledged before a notary public, filed with the Registrar of Corporations; the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation as conclusive evidence of corporate existence.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum issued or paid-up capital. The board may fix the consideration for issued shares, including cash, tangible or intangible property, or services actually rendered (BCA section 47). No escrow account, paid-in reserve, or capital deposit requirement applies to a non-resident domestic corporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Corporation accept the subscription for 10,000 common shares, par value US$1.00, issued to the subscriber identified in the subscription schedule in consideration for the full purchase price paid into the corporate treasury. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the Corporation be and hereby is fixed at the office of the licensed registered agent, Uliga District, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the following persons be, and hereby are, appointed corporate officers: [Name], President; [Name], Treasurer; and [Name], Secretary, each to serve at the pleasure of the Board. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the President is authorized to open bank accounts, engage bookkeepers, and execute all filings required to maintain good standing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Name Clearance Unit, through licensed RMI Registered Agents
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name-clearance request listing the proposed corporate name (with suffix 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', or 'Corp.'), the intended authorized capital, and the incorporator's identity. The Registrar compares the name against the active corporate index; an acceptable name is reserved for 30 calendar days. Proceed to Articles only after written clearance is obtained.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name is refused due to a conflicting name, submit a written reconsideration request with the prior name holder's consent to waiver, or provide up to two alternate names; a denial may be appealed to the High Court within 14 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarial Execution of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered Agent and Notary Public; pre-filing consultation with the Registrar
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation: corporate name, purpose (manufacture of collectible die-cast scale automotive replicas), registered agent and registered office, authorized share classes and par value, director exculpation, indemnification, and any preferred share authorizations. The incorporator executes the Articles before a notary public; the registered agent executes its consent to serve. Deliver one original for examination.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar's pre-filing examiner questions a provision, deliver a conformed amendment page and a re-execution page; any alteration after execution must be initialed by the incorporator and re-notarized.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Filing and Payment of Incorporation Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro; electronic filing via authorized service providers
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Cause the registered agent to file the original Articles with the Registrar together with the US$400 government filing fee, remitted by wire or acceptable clearing method. The Registrar assigns a file number and endorses the filing time. Electronic submissions, where available, require an advanced electronic signature matching the notary-backed execution.
required_dossiers: Submission authority or power of attorney
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a defect letter, the agent has 30 days to file a corrected page or amended certificate; if correction is accepted, the original filing date is preserved.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Registration Division
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After validation, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the corporate number and date of incorporation. Review the certificate against the Articles, obtain a certified copy, and place it in the statutory records book.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation (original or certified copy)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Under BCA section 35, the Registrar may correct a certificate with typographical or clerical error upon a signed correction certificate; substantive changes require Articles of Amendment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Organizational Meeting, Bylaw Adoption, and Officer Appointments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Initial Board of Directors and Corporate Secretary, convened at the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the organizational meeting of the initial board, or execute a unanimous written consent in lieu of meeting, to adopt the Bylaws, elect officers, accept the share subscription, confirm the registered office and agent, and approve the banking resolution. Record all actions in the corporate minute book.
required_dossiers: Unanimous written consent or minutes of first board meeting
Share subscription schedule and certificate stub
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: A latent defect in an organizational action is cured by a ratifying board resolution; if no meeting was held, the sole incorporator or sole director may execute a retroactive approval to evidence validity.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Non-Resident Status Filing and Annual Compliance Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: RMI Registrar of Corporations and Ministry of Finance, Tax Administration and Foreign Investment Business Agency
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the non-resident domestic declaration with the RMI Registrar and notify the Tax Administration that the corporation will derive no income from sources within the Marshall Islands. Establish the annual report and government fee calendar. If any in-country activity is contemplated, obtain the Foreign Investment Business License from FIBA before commencing operations.
required_dossiers: Foreign Investment Business License application (if applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the Tax Administration disputes non-resident status, provide bank records and board minutes showing no local business and appeal through the Ministry of Finance within 30 days; a lapsed annual filing may be reinstated by filing the report and paying the reinstatement fee.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Foreign Investment Business Agency (FIBA) and Business License Division, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands; in-country industrial site approvals also require Majuro Local Government planning and building consent.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: General Business License (Manufacturing) under the Business License Act, together with a Foreign Investment Business License (FIBL) under the Foreign Investment Business Act 2001 for foreign-owned manufacturing activity.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Authority of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMIEPA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Screening-tier Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA Registration) for die-casting and tampo-printing operations; Full EIA and Environmental Statement required where process wastewater would be discharged, hazardous solvent storage exceeds 5,000 liters, or die-casting capacity exceeds 5 tonnes per day.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero process-water discharge to Majuro lagoon; closed-loop cooling and quench water recycling; VOC abatement of not less than 95% via carbon adsorption on tampo-printing lines; zinc dross, spent dies, and waste inks classified and consigned off-island under RMIEPA waste manifests; compliance with WHO-based ambient water quality limits.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate issued by the National Fire Authority covering foundry hot-work areas; structural load certification from the Majuro building inspector for furnace machinery; workplace clearance from the Ministry of Health Occupational Health and Safety Division addressing molten-metal PPE, lead-dust monitoring, and noise exposure controls.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Republic of the Marshall Islands Ministry of Finance, Revenue and Tax Division (Tax and Customs Office); official portal: https://www.rmi-tax.com
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity establishing a non-resident Business Corporation under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act must file Articles of Incorporation with the Registrar of Corporations, appoint a resident registered agent, and pay the applicable filing fee. Following incorporation, the entity must obtain a Tax Identification Number (TIN) by submitting Form REG-1 to the Revenue and Tax Division. Non-resident corporations not engaged in business within the Marshall Islands are not required to obtain a business license and are generally not subject to domestic taxation beyond annual government maintenance fees.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election exists under Marshall Islands law. The non-resident Business Corporation is automatically treated as a separate taxable person for the limited purposes of the Gross Revenue Tax; however, by statute, gross revenue derived from sources outside the Republic of the Marshall Islands is expressly excluded, effectively conferring tax-exempt status on the offshore activity. No elective pass-through regime is available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None (No VAT, GST, sales tax, or other general indirect tax is imposed by the Republic of the Marshall Islands)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable — the Marshall Islands imposes no value-added tax, goods and services tax, or general sales tax. Therefore no economic turnover threshold exists for indirect tax registration. The only local revenue measures are the Gross Revenue Tax (applicable only to revenue sourced within the Marshall Islands) and the Business License Tax (exempt for non-resident business corporations).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Not applicable — the Marshall Islands has no electronic invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, API integration, or digital stamping regime for indirect tax purposes. Invoicing for exported die-cast scale models follows ordinary commercial practice, with no government fiscal clearance requirement.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable — as the Marshall Islands does not operate a VAT/GST system, there is no export zero-rating mechanism, no output tax to relieve, and no input tax credit or refund scheme. Exporters of die-cast scale automotive models from the Marshall Islands are not subject to any indirect tax on export proceeds. The only customs-relevant obligation is compliance with the RMI Customs and Excise Regulations regarding export declarations and movement of goods.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (where required under RMI Customs Regulations)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing shipment from the Marshall Islands
Certificate of Origin (only if preferential tariff treatment is claimed in the destination jurisdiction)
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank SWIFT credit advice evidencing export proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Because there is no export VAT zero-rating, there is no specific VAT clawback or zero-rating fraud penalty. However, false declarations to the RMI Customs Service regarding exported goods are subject to seizure, customs penalties, and potential criminal fines under the Customs and Excise Regulations. Under the Gross Revenue Tax and Business License framework, failure to file accurate returns or maintain adequate export documentation may result in assessment of tax on revenue that the entity claims as non-resident-source, plus interest and penalties of up to 25% of the unpaid amount; fraudulent documentation may attract criminal prosecution.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banking Commission of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (statutory banking and foreign exchange supervisory authority; the RMI is a dollarized economy and maintains no independent central bank)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The U.S. dollar is the sole legal tender and the domestic currency of the Marshall Islands. The RMI imposes no exchange-control regime, no distinction between current and capital account categories, and no licensing requirement for foreign exchange transactions. Profit repatriation, dividend distributions, and capital withdrawals are freely permitted in USD. Practical friction is limited to compliance with U.S. OFAC sanctions, anti-money laundering (AML) due diligence, and correspondent-bank restrictions applicable to cross-border transfers routed through the U.S. banking system.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There are no statutory export-proceeds surrender requirements, no mandatory conversion ratios, and no requirement to repatriate export earnings to a domestic bank account. Exporters may lawfully retain USD receipts in any jurisdictionally admissible bank; however, corporate accounts opened in the RMI may be subject to contractual bank covenants requiring visibility of trade documents for AML purposes.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (USD current and settlement), optionally segregated Capital Escrow Account
Operational Account (USD current and settlement) for corporate clients; Capital Escrow Account supported under a separate agreement
Not applicable for non-resident commercial treasury operations; development and project finance only

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low viability. The RMI has no bespoke e-money institution (EMI) licensing regime and does not recognize foreign digital EMI e-money accounts as bank accounts for corporate treasury purposes. Non-resident fintech platforms not holding an RMI banking license cannot clear transactions inside the domestic USD banking system. Platforms such as PayPal may be used as receivables collection tools but are not permissible primary clearing rails for trade settlements. A regulated RMI banking relationship is mandatory for liquidity management, capital injection escrow, and documentary trade settlement.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a non-resident Marshall Islands Business Corporation, physical presence of at least one authorized signatory and all 25% or greater beneficial owners at a bank branch interview is the general default standard imposed by RMI-licensed banks. Remote account opening is occasionally permitted subject to strict criteria: prior banking relationship, completion of a notarized and apostilled KYC interview by a recognized introducer, liveness-verified video call with compliance officers, and submission of certified corporate registry documents from the RMI Registrar. Final discretion rests with the bank's AML/CFT compliance unit.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident offshore business corporation and distance from bank branch
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified Articles of Incorporation and Charter; Certificate of Good Standing issued by the RMI Registrar; registered-agent certificate; apostilled board resolution appointing signatories; audited financial statements or an initial funding source breakdown; beneficial-ownership schedule with passport and proof-of-address for each owner; notarized/video-verified director and BO interviews; reference letters from existing trade or corporate bankers.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Geographical nexus involving PRC/HK manufacturing counterparties and die-casting supply chain
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: The complete commercial contract trail for the 1:18 scale model production cycle, including purchase orders from original equipment manufacturers or licensing partners, pro-forma invoices from the zinc-alloy die-casting foundry, logistics and shipping documents, supplier due-diligence reports on third-party suppliers, and tax invoices evidencing the commercial economic substance of the transactions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large or unexplained capital injection into a newly formed entity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Source-of-wealth evidence: personal or corporate bank statements supporting accumulated funds; copies of loan agreements or subscription agreements; certified valuation or sale-of-asset contracts; witness-signed articles of contribution; and a description letter matching the business-model projection of the die-cast automotive collectibles sector.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Expected rapid payment velocity through PayPal or digital wallets without commensurate trade documents
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: The payment-rail rationalization memorandum explaining that PayPal is used primarily for direct-to-consumer e-commerce sales; integration of PayPal transaction reports with order-level sales data; import/export customs declarations, country-of-origin certificates for die-cast models; trademark licensing agreements; and a robust transaction-monitoring threshold policy consistent with the low-risk classification of collectibles manufacturing.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound capital injections must be wired in USD via SWIFT-compliant banking channels to the RMI operating or escrow account. The remitter should use the appropriate cross-border purpose codes required by the sending jurisdiction; within the RMI no FX approval is required, but U.S. correspondent banks may require a beneficiary-specific instruction leading with 'Beneficiary: [MH_BC entity full name], Account Number [XX], Bank Reference [XX]' and any applicable OFAC screening reference. A board resolution authorizing the capital contribution, an escrow agreement (if funds are held pending a condition precedent), and a funds-receipt certificate must be retained to evidence lawful source and purpose. For collection of trade receivables from international distributors, e-commerce marketplace settlements, and licensing royalties, the routing preference is SWIFT MT103 to the operational USD account; payment gateways must be configured to sweep balances daily into the bank account to avoid non-bank float risks.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Settlement for foundry, tooling, packaging, logistics, and licensing payments should be made through the RMI operational account using SWIFT MT103 wire transfers for direct supplier disbursements. For larger or contractually complex transactions, a commercial letter of credit (irrevocable documentary credit) issued by a tier-1 correspondent bank is the preferred clearing rail, with MT700 and MT799 messages for negotiation and amendment. Standby letters of credit may be used for advance payments. Domestic RMI payments are settled in USD on a real-time gross basis via the bank's internal ledger; all disbursements to non-RMI suppliers must clear through the international SWIFT network and U.S. Fedwire/CHIPS infrastructure. Supporting records must include signed purchase orders, invoices, bills of lading, inspection certificates at release, and conformity certificates for the zinc-alloy die-cast production runs.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/CNY Vanilla Forwards (deliverable excluded due to PRC settlement constraints; non-deliverable forwards preferred when offsetting RMB trade payables)
USD/EUR Deliverable or Non-Deliverable Forwards for European distributors and licensing partners
USD/HKD Forwards for scaling, tooling, and Hong Kong intermediary payments
USD/JPY forwards for Japanese OEM and scale-model licensing royalties
Cross-Currency Swaps (USD/CNY and USD/EUR) for multi-year liquidity transformation
Vanilla Currency Swaps via International Swaps and Derivatives Association (ISDA) master agreements with an approved global bank counterparty

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Marshall Islands Annual Report and Government Annual Fee Declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Commerce and Investment, Republic of the Marshall Islands
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after each anniversary date of the initial certificate of incorporation; first annual report due 90 days after filing the certificate of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of up to USD 200 if submitted more than 90 days past the anniversary date; continued non-filing and non-payment for one consecutive year triggers administrative strike-off of the corporation from the Register, after notice by the Registrar, with restoration possible upon payment of all fees and penalties

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is mandatorily required for a non-resident private Business Corporation; an independent audit becomes compulsory if the corporation is listed on a public securities exchange, if shareholders owning in aggregate at least 10% of the outstanding shares deliver a formal written demand, or if the Registrar specifically directs an audit for public-interest reasons
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS or US GAAP permitted; Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act does not prescribe a local statutory GAAP, but financial statements must give a true and fair view for tax-exempt non-resident entities under the accepted international framework

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No public beneficial ownership register or annual UBO confirmation filing exists in the Marshall Islands. The registered agent and corporation are privately obligated to maintain current beneficial ownership records, and registered agents must be updated promptly upon any share transfer resulting in an acquirer holding more than 25% of shares; no statutory annual declaration is required

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 3% flat corporate rate on taxable income derived from sources within the Marshall Islands (RMI Income Tax Act 1989); the rate applies only to RMI-source income and is structurally neutralized for a Non-Resident Business Corporation.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Effective rate 0% for a Non-Resident Business Corporation (BC). The RMI territorial system exempts all foreign-source income; no minimum corporate tax, no branch profits tax, no capital gains tax, no gross-receipts tax, and no statutory tax-holiday certificate is required because the foreign-source exemption is automatic.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: RMI Business Corporations Act Annual Report (Form AR-1) filed electronically through the Marshall Islands International Registry online portal (MIIR Business Registry Portal) administered by the Office of the Registrar of Corporations.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on the anniversary of the date of incorporation; corporations on the legacy cycle must file by the uniform 30 September registry deadline. No extension is available beyond the statutory anniversary date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact corporate name and designation; a Non-Resident BC must reflect any '(Non-Resident)' suffix in its registered name.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the name exactly as shown on the Certificate of Incorporation; do not add a trading name before the registered-agent confirmation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized share capital, including classes and par or no-par value; the annual government fee tier is computed from authorized share count.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Declare the full authorized capital even if no shares are issued; undercapitalization does not remove the filing duty.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office and licensed resident agent within the Marshall Islands.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the licensed agent's RMI address; a foreign management office cannot be substituted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Directors and officers list, with full names and residential addresses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A corporate director or nominee is permitted, but the beneficial owner must be disclosed to the registered agent for AML record-keeping.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of non-resident status confirming no physical office, employees, or revenue sources in the RMI.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Tick the non-resident declaration and attach the agent's certificate to preserve the 0% effective income tax position.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a 10% surcharge per commenced month of delay on the annual government fee (minimum USD 200, maximum USD 2,000); 12 months of continuous default causes administrative dissolution without court order, with loss of the certificate of good standing.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: RMI Corporation Income Tax Return (Form IT-2) filed with the RMI Revenue and Taxation Division, Ministry of Finance; paper lodgement via the registered agent is required unless the taxpayer is enrolled in the RMI Tax Information Portal, in which case electronic lodgement is accepted.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The return must be filed by the 15th day of the fourth month following the close of the taxable year (calendar year ending 31 December unless a different fiscal year is approved by the Minister).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross income derived from sources within the Republic of the Marshall Islands.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only RMI-source gross receipts; revenue from foreign zinc die-casting, tampo printing, and worldwide sales of 1:18 scale replicas is extraterritorial and excluded from the RMI tax base.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductions directly allocable to RMI-source gross income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A Non-Resident BC may deduct only expenses incurred inside the RMI; foreign manufacturing costs, molds, tampo tooling, and group overhead booked offshore are not deductible against any positive RMI base.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income before exemption (Line 1 minus Line 2).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a compliant offshore BC this line is zero; attach the annual AR-1 receipt as supporting evidence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income tax computed at 3% on Line 3.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compute only if positive RMI-source taxable income exists; otherwise insert USD 0.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-resident exemption election under the foreign-source exemption rule of the Income Tax Act.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Tick the election and attach a signed declaration confirming that the place of effective management, production facility, and principal hazard of business are located outside the RMI; the effective tax rate is 0% on the full foreign-source net profit.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Disclosure of related-party transactions with group entities, distributors, and licensees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: List transactions above USD 250,000 per counterparty; attach an arm's-length benchmark if a foreign tax authority challenges the transfer price.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: USD 100 per month, capped at USD 1,000; late payment: 1% monthly interest plus a 10% negligence penalty; willful non-filing is a misdemeanor punishable by a fine of up to USD 5,000 and/or imprisonment for up to one year.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — the RMI Income Tax Act imposes no withholding tax on dividends paid by a Business Corporation to shareholders resident outside the Marshall Islands; a taxable RMI-source dividend arises only where the corporation derives income from RMI real property or RMI government contracts, which is structurally avoided by the offshore BC.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The Marshall Islands maintains no comprehensive double tax agreements (DTAs) and no general tax information exchange agreements; treaty-based withholding relief is therefore unavailable. If a future DTA is ratified, the required protocol is: (i) file RMI Form WT-1 (Non-Resident Withholding Tax Exemption) before payment; (ii) submit the foreign tax-residency certificate (TRC) issued by the treaty counterparty's revenue authority; and (iii) obtain the RMI Revenue and Taxation Division's written approval before remitting the dividend, royalty, or interest payment.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate 0% on both IP royalties and debt interest paid to non-residents; the RMI does not impose thin-capitalization restrictions, interest-limitation rules, or a branch remittance tax, and royalties for IP licensed for use exclusively outside the RMI are treated as foreign-source.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory RMI transfer-pricing documentation threshold is codified for Non-Resident Business Corporations. Best-practice trigger levels: prepare a Local File where annual RMI-related-party transactions exceed USD 250,000, and prepare Master File/transfer-pricing policy at the group level where consolidated worldwide revenue exceeds USD 100,000,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The RMI Economic Substance Regulations 2019 apply to RMI tax-resident entities carrying on relevant activities (banking, insurance, shipping, pure equity holding, IP holding, headquarters, financing/leasing, and distribution/service centers). Die-cast manufacturing of physical scale models is not a listed relevant activity, but a trading-heavy distribution model can be recharacterized as a distribution and service center if inventory is held or purchasing decisions are made through an RMI presence. A Non-Resident BC that files the annual ESR notification and proves a foreign place of effective management and foreign tax residence remains exempt from the substance test; failing the ESR notification exposes the entity to the 3% RMI-source tax and penalties up to USD 50,000.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Mischaracterizing 1:18 scale die-cast model revenue as foreign-source when sales, contracts, and bank accounts are managed from an RMI office; maintaining dual books; signing Line 5 non-resident exemption without a genuine foreign place of management.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Civil fraud penalty of 50% of the underpaid tax plus monthly interest of 1%; criminal conviction carries a fine of up to USD 10,000 and/or imprisonment for up to 3 years; the Revenue and Taxation Division may reconstruct RMI-source gross income from the last 6 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Under the fraudulent-trading rule of the Business Corporations Act, directors signing or directing the false return are jointly and severally liable for the full corporate tax debt; the High Court may impose a departure-prohibition order and asset freeze against the director pending settlement and may order personal restitution.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Economic Substance Deficiencies
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating as a letter-box BC with no RMI office, staff, or physical books while claiming non-resident exemption; failing to file the annual ESR notification; or routing international royalty and interest payments through the shell without foreign tax-residence proof.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ESR penalty of USD 10,000 per relevant activity, capped at USD 50,000; suspension of the certificate of good standing; a second-year default leads to mandatory striking-off and asset forfeiture to the liquidator under the ESR Enforcement Manual.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be personally assessed for outstanding ESR penalties after dissolution; the High Court may disqualify a director from managing any RMI company for up to 5 years and issue an international travel restriction based on unpaid regulatory penalties.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using SWIFT wire and PayPal payment rails to launder proceeds, including over-invoicing or under-invoicing the export price of die-cast car replicas, repeated disputed chargebacks as cash proxies, transacting with sanctioned persons, or structuring wire transfers below the AML reporting threshold to avoid scrutiny.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the RMI Anti-Money Laundering Act and Criminal Code, money laundering is punishable by imprisonment for up to 20 years and a fine of up to USD 500,000; the die-cast inventory, injection molds, tampo-printing equipment, and bank balances are subject to criminal forfeiture; the company faces debarment from the licensed registered-agent network.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil is pierced automatically upon a money-laundering conviction; directors, beneficial owners, and the appointed AML compliance officer are personally indictable, subject to bench-warrant travel bans, pre-trial asset seizure, and personal restitution judgments equal to the full laundered amount.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Annual Report Default and Administrative Dissolution
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to file Form AR-1 by the incorporation anniversary; allowing the licensed RMI registered agent to lapse; or trading after losing the certificate of good standing.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Late-payment surcharge of 10% per commenced month (minimum USD 200, maximum USD 2,000); after 12 months of continuous default, the Registrar administratively dissolves the corporation; contracts concluded after dissolution are unenforceable and the corporate name may be re-registered by a third party.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who continue trading for more than 60 days after service of the dissolution notice are personally liable for all debts contracted during that period; the Minister of Finance may also issue a certificate of tax indebtedness enforceable personally against the directors in the High Court.
